patterns: APPSC asks one-line facts: net-zero year (2070), updated NDC intensity target (45%), base year 2005, LiFE full form, 119th ISA member (Malta).
Recurring traps: 33-35% (not 30-35%) INDC; installed capacity not generation; net zero = balancing emissions with removals, not zero emissions.
Other PSCs ask CCPI rank and publisher, REDD+ firsts.
App goes much deeper (CCTS mechanics, storage GW, climate-finance shares, 2026 portals) with many multi-statement items; the exam stays at headline-number level.
